## FAQs

- **What does ASCENTIA do?** ASCENTIA provides AI agents, marketing automation, UAV operations, and AI compliance services for European businesses.
- **Where is ASCENTIA based?** Bratislava, Slovakia (Klincová 37/B, 821 08 Bratislava - Ružinov).
- **Is ASCENTIA GDPR compliant?** Yes. Our systems follow GDPR, EU AI Act, and NIS2 by design. Privacy policy available at /privacy.
- **What is the AI Act disclaimer?** Per EU Regulation 2024/1689 (AI Act), some services involve AI systems intended to interact with natural persons. See footer disclaimer.
- **Who is the founder?** Marian Stancik — AI Engineer, UAV pilot (EASA A1/A3), Law student at Faculty of Law, Comenius University.
- **What hosting do you use?** European VPS (Hetzner Cloud) for agents, Vercel Edge for web. No US cloud for core infrastructure.
- **What languages do you support?** Primarily Slovak and English.
- **Can I get a consultation?** Yes. Contact via /contact. First consultation is free.

## Architecture

- **Frontend:** Zero-build vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Vercel Edge
- **Agent runtime:** Hermes Agent (Nous Research) on Hetzner VPS
- **LLM provider:** OpenRouter (DeepSeek, Claude, GPT via dynamic routing)
- **Memory:** Obsidian vault + SQLite, Syncthing sync
- **Email:** AgentMail (marian_stancik@agentmail.to)
- **Media storage:** Cloudflare R2 (ascentia-media bucket, EEUR region)
- **SEO/GEO:** Schema.org JSON-LD, llms.txt, sitemap, robots.txt

## Key Differentiators

1. **European infrastructure** — 100% EU-hosted, no US cloud dependency
